**Best move:** Qxf2+

**Main line:** Qxf2+ Kxf2 Nxf3 (or any developing move; Black is winning with an extra queen)

**Motif:** hangingPiece (the White queen is undefended due to the pin)

**Explanation:**
The White queen on f2 is completely pinned to the king by your queen on e3—if it moves, you have check. Even though White just moved Qf2, you can capture it with check (Qxf2+). After Kxf2 (forced), you've won the queen for nothing, a decisive material advantage worth ~9 points. Always scan for pinned pieces, especially when they're attacked—an undefended pinned piece is a gift.
